description: Value of the signed-in user's active shelf (opened + unopened) in USD, the same number as the app's Stats. paid: purchase price, or MSRP when no price was entered (msrpCount says how many used MSRP). msrp: every bottle at MSRP. excludedCount bottles have no usable price. totalCents is exact; total is dollars. Always scoped to the token uid.
name: get_shelf_value
